# Muse Hub

> Community-built source for **15 independent Muse assistants**, each with Main and three subchats; 75 skills, 25 workflows, 100 task starters, local examples and 151 connector records. Not affiliated with the Muse platform. A source record is not a live connection.

- [Muse Hub repository](https://github.com/atlas-origins/muse-ai-agent-presets)

## Hub scope
- [Muse Hub status and product boundaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atlas-origins/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/hub/README.md)

## Boundaries
- Each role is intended for its own Muse assistant/account. Do not combine the 15 Main conversations or their private subchat memories.
- The source kits are not a native Muse installation, authenticated accounts, or guarantees of model-backed autonomous execution.
- The independent Muse Hub discovery/workspace is an integration goal within this repository, not a released hosted or connected product.
- Connector records document available source and setup routes; account connection and tool permissions must be established by the user.
- Use original provider documentation, current version requirements, and appropriate authorizations before executing local code.
